The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash controls oil and gently exfoliates with **antioxidant-rich green tea and glycolic acid**.

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash uses **natural neem and turmeric** to clear impurities and prevent oily-skin breakouts.
